info.text: Formal flood incident recorded affecting various locations in Barrington on 17 July 2015 (Formal Flood Investigation reference FI/1/60). Risk Management Authorities recorded as Environment Agency and Cambridgeshire County Council.

Extremely intense, localised rainfall overwhelmed drainage networks and inundated watercourses and the road network in the village, producing surface water on roads, overtopping of watercourses and surcharging of local drains; at least three properties in the community flooded internally.
Area experienced flooding associated with the incident on 17 July 2015; properties were flooded and the County will add Barrington to its list of wetspots.
The culverted outfall that runs under Haslingfield Road was implicated in the flooding incident and is the focus of the commissioned surface water drainage assessment.
